collection.seed: public closed OHLCV only; historical events/outcomes never enter forward sample
collection.first_eligible_bar: open >= first UTC hour boundary strictly after activation timestamp
collection.receipt: original bytes, public URL/query, request start, receive UTC, exchange time, HTTP status and hash
collection.recovery: chronological, actual late receipt preserved, forward_eligible false when late; never fabricate original emissions
collection.price_revision: append revision notice and degrade; never rewrite first vintage
collection.storage: future independent volume; no shared Guardian or weekly-journal storage
collection.activation: separate human approval and collector review required; no scheduler/network transport included

outcomes.reference: frozen hypothetical next-H1 open after confirmation, with .0005 adverse slip; not an observed fill
outcomes.exit: H1 open reference+horizon, adverse .0005; known only when that H1 closes
outcomes.actual_capture_latency: record whether reference time precedes recorded prediction; never claim that open was executable
outcomes.funding: separate original public USD-M receipts with full range coverage; missing coverage/mark => net UNKNOWN, not zero. Price outcome can precede separately appended costed outcome.
outcomes.boundary_funding: retain original conservative/optimistic settlement ordering bounds; exact null when ambiguous

baseline.population: every closed eligible observed H1, both directional price labels, including event hours and neighboring periods
baseline.primary_unit: unique observation_id, never summed pattern claims
baseline.overlap: same-time side group plus fixed UTC7day bootstrap blocks; cross-profile/pattern duplicates retained as labels, not independent samples
baseline.coverage: all expected hours, missing and late rows reported; no minimum-result-based selection
baseline.inference: descriptive until predeclared cohort maturity; six22 Holm comparisons unchanged;11 and sidecar exploratory, no automatic strategy validation
baseline.power_caveat: New inclusive baseline changes the paired-excess estimand and its variance. Do not transplant legacy sigma or claim adequate power from raw event count. No performance-dependent sample extension.

comparative.external_context: Owner-supplied summary of another chat/Telegram; no direct transcript access, no certified numerical labels or training outcomes
comparative.mtf_definition: closed-complete UTC buckets, weeklyMonday00; public indicator facts and close/SMA200 proxy, NOT original Direction Engine; incomplete warmup UNKNOWN

structure.breakout: closed close strictly outside prior20H high/low, levels exclude current
structure.recovery: cross back over frozen broken level within4 closed bars
structure.rejection: wick crosses prior20H level while entire closed body returns inside
structure.failed_rebound: after recovery, crosses back across same frozen level within4 bars; symmetric failed pullback

watch_states.WATCH_SHORT: AO<0, -DI>+DI, and AO slope<0 or fresh structural downside break
watch_states.WATCH_REBOUND: AO<0 and AO slope>0 and pececillos slope>0; observation against negative AO context
watch_states.WATCH_SHORT_REENTRY: a WATCH_REBOUND in preceding4h, then AO<0 and AO/pececillos slopes<0 with -DI>+DI; precedence over WATCH_SHORT
watch_states.meaning: observational labels, not instructions, never part of22/11 gates

comparative.parameters_status: explicit new unvalidated measurement conventions; no fit to15Nov or historical returns

cohort.duration: fixed12 months, final read after endpoint+24h+closed-data delay; coverage checks only before final
cohort.sample_target: Legacy22 development effective-n targets are planning references and minimum floors, not a calibrated power guarantee for the new inclusive-census contrast; independent final inference review required. Insufficient => NO TESTABLE.
